### Added

- (agent-platform) [List and read skills through the installation's skill-manager](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3432) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — The New agent page lists the skills and plugins of the installation the agent goes to, read from that installation's skill-manager, and a private skill repository you can't read says why instead of listing skills you can't use.
- (agent-platform) [The organization credential form](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3435) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Organization admins enter a model key or connector credential on a portal page that first shows which organization and object it is for, which other objects read it and where the value is sent; the value is never shown again.
- (muster) [Sort the Connectors list by name, by header click, all at once](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3444) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Customize · Connectors lists every connector on one page in alphabetical order, and a click on a column header sorts by that column.
- (ui-react) [One new-tab icon for every external link, and link a skill's Path](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3443) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Every link and button that opens a new tab shows the same new-tab icon, and a skill's `Path` links to its SKILL.md on GitHub at the latest commit.
- (several plugins) [Put muster's URL elicitations to the person and retry the call with their answer](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3459) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — When a tool needs you to sign in first, the portal shows the sign-in page's address in its confirmation dialog and runs the tool once you've signed in. A running tool's `Run` offers `Cancel`.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Restore private skill catalogs after reload](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3452) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — The new-agent wizard's Skills step no longer crashes after a page reload when the skill catalog it kept includes private repositories.
- (agent-platform) [Set an agent reply's paragraphs at 14px again](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3455) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — In a session, an agent's replies and a skill's instructions are set at the same text size as your own messages again, quoted text and reasoning are in their quieter colour, and an expanded section stays open while a reply streams in.

### Development and CI/CD

- (docs) [Move agent instructions to AGENTS.md](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3454) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The instructions for coding agents move from `.claude/CLAUDE.md` to `AGENTS.md` and the skills to `.agents/skills`, so Claude Code, Codex and Cursor read the same files.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.35.1...v3.36.0
